why: The client's own photographs, from the client's own live site, for a redesign prototype OF that site. Not stock; not for reuse on another build.
parked_here_because: scratchpad is wiped on process restart (HARD memory). Move into iceland-redesigns/public/fjorubordid/ with this manifest when the build is approved.
the_finding: Their ORIGINALS are enormous and their website serves thumbnails. MG_8523.jpg is 4722x3148 and A4A5682.jpg is 3728x3728 on their own server, but the largest image the homepage actually renders is 450px wide and most pages top out at 260px. They already own the photography the redesign needs; the site throws it away. Recovered by stripping the WordPress -WxH size suffix from the served URL.
already_dark: black-wood-e1504817995775.jpg (1920x1080) is a black timber plank texture already in their own visual language, which is the bridge to the MELLOW reference's dark ground. Their accent red is real too: the napkins in slidenew4, the chair and wall in A4A5682, and the gift certificates.

logo.how: potrace vector trace of their 260x95 PNG, then recoloured to their own dominant logo red #ec3c20 sampled off the original, plus a cream #e8e2d6 cut for the dark ground. 24 paths, scales to any size.
logo.why_not_ai: An AI upscale of a transparent logo mattes the alpha edges (memory: ai-upscale-transparent-logo-matting). Tracing is free, exact and resolution-independent. Zero credits.
logo.note: Still ask the client for the original vector; this trace is faithful but it is a trace.
